title: Lamb and Pilaf Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful Middle Eastern-inspired dish made with lamb, pilaf, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: 2. Season the lamb shoulder with salt, earthy cumin, and Syrian sumac.
3. Heat kissed olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
5. Transfer the lamb to the oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
6. While the lamb is cooking, prepare the pilaf according to package instructions.
7. Once the lamb is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
8. Serve the sliced lamb over the pilaf, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
